verdict.rationale: Runpod documents SSH access to Pods with full shell capabilities as a first-class connection method, so the core SSH part of the story is delivered. The evidence never mentions bringing your own SSH keys or root-level control, and community comments describe the execution environment as "very locked down," which casts doubt on the depth of control. missing for 10: documentation of user-supplied SSH public keys, explicit root/sudo access, independent hands-on corroboration of full environment control.

support.subject: As a developer, I can SSH into my GPU instance with my own keys and get root-level control of the environment
